observations.interpretation: When no truthy iss.message/earlier non-nullish map result wins, the helper may invoke error-map callbacks including ctx.error/config.customError/config.localeError. The shown helper has no local catch around those calls. A throwing callback can prevent normal return. This is a conditional possibility, not an observed failure or a claim every callback runs.

The initial key copy omits input, then ctx.reportInput truthiness can add full.input = iss.input. An unconditional finalizeIssue-always-drops-input claim is contradicted by the expanded callee source.

The source comment about dropped input is not a universal object-retention or process-memory guarantee. The original owner chapter explicitly avoids certifying memory reclamation, and that caution is supported by expanded context.
